prompts.method:

Asset type: 2D game animation sprite sheet for a native64 square-grid roguelike, review prototype of walking, not a redesign.
EDIT INPUT1: replace all twelve orange armored Bastions with the character from INPUT2. Preserve the EXACT camera and six walking POSES in INPUT1; the torso stays almost front-on, with only slight left/right three-quarter orientation, BOTH shoulders and front of chest clearly visible. Do not turn to side profile.
INPUT2 is the EXACT accepted character design: slim female Traqueuse, dark brown bun, blue optical eyepiece, navy scarf and tactical clothing, asymmetrical pale silver chest panel, bare right upper arm, armored left sleeve/forearm, dark trousers, asymmetric silver shin armor and boots. Preserve her actual physique, face, outfit, colors and proportions. Do not copy Bastion's thick body or armor.
Output ONE perfectly regular atlas, exactly SIX columns and TWO rows, twelve distinct COMPLETE full-body walking frames, same scale in every cell. Canvas1536x512, cells256square, body height208, sole baseline236. Clear transparent gutters, whole boots/head.
Row1: front-left three-quarter walking screen LEFT, copying the TOP row of INPUT1. Row2: front-right three-quarter walking screen RIGHT, copying BOTTOM row. Minimal change of torso angle from front, not profile. No backs.
Every row is one coherent SIX-FRAME measured walk cycle in time order, with the same modest knee and foot movements as INPUT1. Copy its compact stepping silhouette and joint positions for each corresponding cell, adapted to her slender physique. Arms swing gently, grounded weight transfer, minimal bob. No jumping, running, wide straddling or repeated lifted-leg pose. Preserve the same anatomy/head size across all frames.
Match INPUT2's matte illustrated game finish, bold readable shapes, crisp nuanced contours. Transparent alpha throughout, no floor, shadows, text, labels, grid, weapons, new outfit details or glow.
